MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  August 5, 2019

 A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
 order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
 Estates, CA 90274, by CHAIR ZIGRANG.

 2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR ZIGRANG led those assembled in the salute to the flag

 3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONER’S PRESENT:  Schachter, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo

  COMMISSIONER’S ABSENT:  Scott, Medawar, Edler

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Manager Naughton
  Administrative Assistant Corea

 4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

 A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF JULY 1, 2019

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF JULY 1, 2019

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

 5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

 6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

 A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO
  to,

  APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

 7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

 A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-13-19; APPLICANT: MR. SEONG KIM; LOCATION: 2
  SINGLETREE LANE; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is requested to
  construct at 513 SF second story addition to an existing split-level residence.

  Planning Manager Naughton provided a PowerPoint presentation with a summary of the
  staff report for Planning Application No. PA-13-19.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission
  approve Planning Application PA-13-19, approving the Neighborhood Compatibility
  Determination, subject to the Conditions of Approval outlined in the staff report.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION PA-13-19, APPROVING THE
  NEIGHBORHOOD COMPATIBILITY DETERMINATION, SUBJECT TO THE
  CONDITIONS OUTLINED BY STAFF.

Planning Commission Meeting
August 5, 2019
   Ayes: SCHACHTER, ZIGRANG, CARMAN, YOO
  Noes:
  Absent: SCOTT, MEDAWAR, EDLER
  Abstain:

  B.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-14-19; APPLICANT: MS. IRENE LIM; 50
  RANCHVIEW ROAD; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is requested to
  construct one-story additions into the front and side yard setbacks and increase the existing
  roof height. A Minor Deviation is requested to decrease the front yard area by less than
  10% and for the encroachment of the proposed additions into the required front yard which
  does not project closer to the property line than the forwardmost building line. A second
  Minor Deviation is requested for a single-story addition to be built along existing building
  lines that encroach into a side yard setback that is legally nonfconforming.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  CONTINUE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-14-19 TO THE ADJOURNED
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 3, 2019.

  Ayes: SCHACHTER, ZIGRANG, CARMAN, YOO
  Noes:
  Absent: SCOTT, MEDAWAR, EDLER
  Abstain:

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None

  10.  STAFF ITEMS

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that City Hall renovations are almost complete and
  staff will be moving back to City Hall within the following week. The temporary trailer will be
  removed as of September 3, 2019.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff will be bringing a roof study session for review
  by the Planning Commission. There are changes to the building code in regards to cool
  roofs which will go into effect at the beginning of 2020. This may have serious implications
  to the city’s roof building standards.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN inquired about the CalWater project. Planning Manager
  Naughton stated that staff has weekly meetings with CalWater, and staff from Rancho
  Palos Verdes have joined the meetings since work is currently taking place in their city. All
  is going well so far and Rancho Palos Verdes has not received too many complaints. There
  is an issue with the location of staging areas, which will need to be addressed.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER, Planning Manager
  Naughton stated that it is anticipated that the project may reach Silver Spur Road and
  Crenshaw Blvd. in the winter or spring.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JULY 23, 2019

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-C
